khm.text: Koma, the Cosmos Serpent, was kept from every realm after the Skoti overthrew the Einir gods, and Fynn stabbed it, its poisonous blood turning his own to poison.

Fynn's dream warned that the Cosmos Serpent would break its cage and swallow the light of Starnheim, and Tibalt made it real, using the Sword of the Realms to open an Omenpath for Koma into Starnheim.

Koma tore into the sky above Starnheim as a massive armored eel, and Niko, who had warned the Valkyries, joined them in baiting it with mirror traps and driving it back through the portal, sacrificing the stability of Starnheim's dock.
Later a new rift opened and Koma emerged again, diving into the Karfell rift to disrupt the undead flow as Valkyries poured out of their own rift to attack the demons.

fdn.text: Fynn challenged Koma to a rematch, calling on him to come and reclaim what he had lost.
